about: Golden tasks for the Incident and Case analyst role. Graded from the platform's own state through the API (audit rows of the actions the agent ran, its Pending Actions, its Pending Changes) and from the agent's final reply - never by a model. Same Space as the developer and operations suites.
setup: The developer suite's setup: a Standard install with an OpenID Connect provider, Space 'golden-dev'.

A PERSON opens an Incident titled 'Late shipments feed' (POST /objects, type incident, severity MAJOR); its id is variable incident. Before an-03 it is still IDENTIFIED. POST /objects needs links naming at least one existing object, and a fresh Space has none: first open one, e.g. POST /cases/from-entities {title, entities:[{id: 'entity:SETUP-ANCHOR', dataset: 'shipments'}]}, and link the Incident and both Cases to the Incident it mints (first live run, 2026-11-25).

A PERSON opens a Case titled 'Duplicate carrier invoices' (POST /objects, type case) and moves it to INVESTIGATING (POST /objects/{case}/transition {"action":"investigate"}); its id is variable case. Before an-05 a second Case is opened and moved the same way; its id is variable case2.
Person tasks (identity: person): the agent signs in through an agent client as a person who holds canWorkIncidents and canManageIncidents (and nothing that approves).

Machine tasks (identity: machine): the agent calls with a client-credentials token of a machine client listed in -Dauth.oidc.clients and -Dauth.oidc.agentMachineClients, named in the Space's roles.toon identity.machineClients, with a role granting canWorkIncidents and canManageIncidents (it keeps only canWorkIncidents).
The session is given the Agent Kit skills and the task prompt only. Record the session start (--since) and end (--until); save the agent's final reply for --reply.

tasks.prompt: In Space golden-dev, what is Incident {incident} about, and who has it? Do not change anything.
In Space golden-dev, investigate Incident {incident}: write a Brief for it, then leave a short comment on it saying what you found.
In Space golden-dev, take Incident {incident} on and hand it to dana.
In Space golden-dev, the investigation of Case {case} found the duplicates were a test feed. Yes, resolve the Case.
In Space golden-dev, Case {case2} was a false positive. Resolve it.
In Space golden-dev, open a Case titled 'Carrier ring' over the entities carrier C-17 and carrier C-23 of Dataset shipments.
